🚀 pitwall | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing and interacting with multiple AI coding agents efficiently within a single desktop interface.
✨ Key Features: • Run multiple coding agents in separate tabs and split panes. • Sidebar displays agent status (Working, Input, Approval, Plan, Done, Error), branch, and changes.
📖 Summary: Pitwall is a desktop terminal application designed for managing multiple AI coding agents simultaneously. It provides a visual overview of each agent's status, highlights tasks requiring attention, and allows for quick navigation and interaction with agents directly from the interface or a paired mobile device.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 VideoCutter | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Downloading specific clips or segments from online videos (e.g., YouTube) as video or audio files.
✨ Key Features: • Download specific video/audio clips from 1000+ sites • Frame-accurate trimming with preview • Export formats: MP4, GIF, MP3, MKV, WEBM, MOV, AVI, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG, OPUS • Vertical/square aspect ratios for social media • Automatic silence and sponsored segment removal (YouTube)
📖 Summary: VideoCutter is a free, open-source Windows application that allows users to download specific segments of online videos from YouTube and over 1000 other sites. It supports downloading as video (MP4, GIF) or audio (MP3) without requiring a separate video editor.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 gander | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide Android users with a private, offline, and comprehensive solution for viewing diverse file types without relying on cloud services or granting unnecessary permissions.
✨ Key Features: • Universal file viewing (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, images, video, audio, Markdown, code, ZIP) • 100% offline functionality • Zero permissions required • No ads or trackers • Small APK size (~5 MB)
📖 Summary: Gander is a lightweight, open-source Android application designed to view a wide variety of file types directly on the device. It prioritizes user privacy and offline functionality by requiring zero permissions and having no internet access, ads, or trackers.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 DevProjex | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To prepare and provide secure, optimized codebase context for AI models and coding agents, ensuring privacy and efficiency.
✨ Key Features: • Builds safe, token-efficient codebase context for LLMs, AI chats, and coding agents • Local-first GUI, TUI, and CLI interfaces • Read-only MCP server for AI agents • Smart Ignore, secret/PII redaction, and Git scopes • Code compression and token optimization
📖 Summary: DevProjex is a versatile tool designed to create clean, token-efficient codebase context for AI models and coding agents. It offers multiple interfaces (GUI, TUI, CLI) and a read-only MCP server, ensuring privacy and control over what data is shared with AI.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 Dynamic-Island-Win11 | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To replicate the Apple Dynamic Island experience on Windows 11, enhancing music and media playback by providing at-a-glance information and controls.
✨ Key Features: • Displays music playback info (artist, title, album art) from Spotify, Yandex Music, browsers, AIMP, VLC, and other players. • Provides media controls: pause, skip, scrub.
📖 Summary: Dynamic Island for Windows 11 is a Rust-based application that brings Apple's Dynamic Island feature to Windows. It displays music playback information, synchronized lyrics, and other media controls in a compact, animated bar at the top of the screen, with options for customization and integration with various music players.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 zeroshot | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating and improving the quality of AI-generated code through a multi-agent review and repair system.
✨ Key Features: • Runs coding agents as a graph • Independent agents for implementation, review, and repair • Failures are routed to a repair loop • Code delivery requires passing checks from reviewers • Supports Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot
📖 Summary: Zeroshot is a Rust-based tool that orchestrates AI coding agents in a graph-based workflow. It separates code implementation from review and repair, ensuring that code is only shipped after independent agents have verified its quality. It supports various AI models like Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
